correctness.rationale: Correctly normalized conditional group payoff difference equals r omega^k/G-1; binomial moment gives F_G. F_G is convex, its strictly negative x=0 value and F_G(1)=Q_G-1 give exact scalar phase portrait. Moment Cauchy–Schwarz and (G^2-1)/G^2<1 yield strict integer-index log-convexity; mass above omega=1 implies Q_G diverges. Exact integer signs at G=5,6,7,17,18 plus increasing adjacent ratios certify all infinitely many G. value.rationale: The stochastic nonlinear public-goods aggregation question requires judging cooperation attraction as group size varies, not merely finding an equilibrium for one fixed G. The theorem forbids arbitrarily many alternating extinction and cooperation-attracting size bands for every fixed compact random geometric environment. A fully exact and stable example exhibits the nontrivial reentrant pattern, proving the restriction sharp at one unfavorable band and giving a decision-useful group-size consequence.
